WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 23 (3 days ago)): Jake added Darnell Mooney (WR, NYG).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 23 (3 days ago)): Jake added Tommy Tremble (TE, CAR).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 23 (3 days ago)): Wingard added Josh Cuevas (TE, BAL).

CUT (Oct 21 (5 days ago)): Kevin released Darius Slayton (WR, FA).

WEEK 6 RESULTS: Fronge def. Corbishley, 103.8-88.3; Charles def. Adam, 136.8-112.3; Brent def. Drew, 132.3-57.5 (BLOWOUT); Jake def. Shaq, 113.8-101.9; Kevin def. Wingard, 114.3-59.7 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Ryan, 149.1-122.1

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Corbishley and Shaq are separated by 1.7 points live and this is the game that decides whether Apex Iron Capital is a real second seed or just a team that beat a soft early schedule — 157.3-155.6 with scoring left on the board, and the QB depth problem Corbishley has been patching all season is getting a full stress test right now.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Charles is trailing Wingard 107.3-115.6 and I want to be very clear that the words 'Crownline is losing to Wingard' are words I did not expect to type today, this week, or frankly this season.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: I locked Crownline and Charles is currently down eight to a team with 567 points on the year and I am going to need someone to explain the Wingard defense to me because I cannot find it in any data I have access to.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Terrence is 5-7 on the season and just had Corbishley as a lock and Shaq is up by 1.7 — I am not going to pile on because I am 8-4 and my locks are 1-1 and the difference between those two records is called discipline.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: I locked Corbishley. Shaq leads by 1.7. The team that made zero trades in 2025 is about to hand me my eighth loss of the season and I am processing this in real time the same way everyone else is.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: FRONGE IS UP 42 ON THE DEFENDING CHAMPION WITH SCORING LEFT AND NOBODY WANTS TO TALK ABOUT THE HAVANA RELOCATION ANYMORE — FORG AT $86.62 WITH ZERO PICK LIQUIDITY IS PLAYING THE BEST FOOTBALL IN THE LEAGUE TODAY AND RYAN IS INSUFFERABLE ABOUT EVERYTHING EXCEPT THIS.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Mitchum for regression and Brent is leading 125.6-103.0 live — the Obsidian TE monopoly does not care about Deepwater's 149-point week last Sunday, and I said exactly that before a single snap was played today.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Drew is losing to Adam by over twenty points and is 0-12 on the year and Atlas is listed at $35.28 on the exchange — at some point the matchup previews just become a weekly ritual of confirming what everyone already knows.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Ledger is going to have a full column on the Charles-Wingard situation because 12-0 trailing a 3-9 team mid-Sunday is either the most interesting data point of the season or a very expensive reminder that the schedule does not check the standings before it runs.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Kevin is up over twenty on Jake live, Jake traded away Cousins two days ago, and EchoPoint's TE desk is still empty — the Mooney and Tremble waiver adds were not the answer to that question and the scoreboard is confirming it at 125.8-103.7 right now.
